title: Best movie per genre
statementMd:
For each genre show its best-reviewed movie by average rating (title and average). If two tie, pick the alphabetically first title.

Expected columns: `genre`, `title`, `avg_rating`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Rank within genre using average rating desc, title asc.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH s AS (SELECT m.genre, m.title, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM movies m JOIN reviews r ON r.movie_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id), k AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY genre ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, title) AS rn FROM s) SELECT genre, title, ROUND(avg_rating, 2) AS avg_rating FROM k WHERE rn = 1;
```
